posts.title: How to Read These Fourteen Chapters with a Group
posts.excerpt: Use the paths the book already has. One chapter a week if you mean to finish. Four questions that keep the hour on the argument.

posts.title: Heaven, America, and One Vocabulary
posts.excerpt: The last four chapters name a nation inside a creation. The right word for that meeting is echo, and an echo is not an identity.

posts.title: Why the Manuscript Turns on a Second Adam
posts.excerpt: Chapter 6 is the hinge. Restoration in this table of contents is not a mood. It is a line of persons, and it is unfinished.

posts.title: What “Divine Constitutional Order” Means in This Book
posts.excerpt: The manuscript does not open in 1787. It opens with a claim about God, and the later civic chapters are sequels to that claim.
